versionLabel: Version 3.5 - JP Morgan AI factor enhancement
status: All 15 research strategies are included in train / validation / test evaluation. Version 3.5 keeps the JP Morgan research theme and deepens it through shared AI factor scoring, regime, liquidity, quality, low-vol and crowding overlays.

splits.label: Train
splits.purpose: Estimate baseline behavior and fit time-series / ML components.

splits.label: Validation
splits.purpose: Select parameters without touching the final test period.

splits.label: Test
splits.purpose: Final out-of-sample evaluation using parameters chosen on validation.

objective.reason: The objective rewards risk-adjusted return and drawdown efficiency, while discouraging large drawdowns. Version 3.5 tests whether JP Morgan-style AI factor enhancements improve this score without changing the research theme.

models.name: V1 Momentum-Vol Research Model
models.note: Version 3.5 - JP Morgan AI factor enhancement: 252-day stock momentum plus JP Morgan-style quality, low-vol and crowding controls; top 3; 10.0% vol target

parameters.trainingMeaning: V1 3.5 training means selecting stable momentum parameters while testing whether JP Morgan-style quality, low-vol and crowding overlays improve robustness.

approval.reason: Research candidate only; evidence is not strong enough for approval.

models.name: V2 HMM-GARCH-MVO
models.note: Version 3.5 HMM-GARCH-MVO: two-state regime model, GARCH risk forecast, capped MVO, and JP Morgan AI factor expected-return adjustment.

parameters.trainingMeaning: V2 3.5 training means estimating HMM/GARCH and testing whether the JP Morgan AI factor overlay improves MVO expected-return inputs.

approval.reason: Weak out-of-sample or risk-adjusted evidence under the current settings.

models.name: V3 Boosted Trees + Attribution
models.note: Version 3.5 walk-forward boosted stumps with JP Morgan AI factor features, regime/liquidity/crowding inputs and additive feature attribution.

parameters.trainingMeaning: V3 3.5 training means fitting boosted stumps with JP Morgan-style AI factor features and validating feature/parameter robustness.

approval.reason: Useful signal, but parameters or turnover/drawdown controls need more work.

models.name: S1 AI Capex Momentum+
models.note: Version 3.5 JP Morgan AI infrastructure strategy: capex momentum plus AI factor confirmation, liquidity/risk penalty, volatility targeting and hedge sleeve.

parameters.trainingMeaning: Train the AI-capex factor weight and hedge sleeve so the strategy does not simply chase technology beta.

approval.reason: Strong validation/test risk-adjusted performance with acceptable drawdown.

models.name: S2 Quality Growth Barbell+
models.note: Version 3.5 quality-growth barbell: quality proxy, AI factor score, growth acceleration, low-vol hedge that expands during market stress.

parameters.trainingMeaning: Train the quality/growth balance and stress hedge intensity.

approval.reason: Strong validation/test risk-adjusted performance with acceptable drawdown.

models.name: S3 Crowding-Aware Momentum+
models.note: Version 3.5 anti-crowding momentum: JP Morgan-style crowding, liquidity and one-month chase penalties.

parameters.trainingMeaning: Train how strongly the model penalizes crowded or overheated momentum.

approval.reason: Strong validation/test risk-adjusted performance with acceptable drawdown.

models.name: S4 Low-Vol Alpha Shield+
models.note: Version 3.5 low-vol alpha shield: medium trend plus quality, drawdown, low-vol and crowding-aware JP Morgan controls.

parameters.trainingMeaning: Train the low-volatility penalty and conservative risk budget.

approval.reason: Useful signal, but parameters or turnover/drawdown controls need more work.

models.name: S5 Regime-Switch Equity Hedge+
models.note: Version 3.5 regime hedge: JP Morgan macro regime, liquidity, credit and volatility stress decide equity/hedge budget.

parameters.trainingMeaning: Train the macro regime threshold and how much exposure shifts into hedges.

approval.reason: Strong validation/test risk-adjusted performance with acceptable drawdown.

models.name: S6 Credit-Liquidity Accelerator+
models.note: Version 3.5 credit-liquidity accelerator: high-yield/Treasury proxy plus JP Morgan liquidity and regime score before increasing beta.

parameters.trainingMeaning: Train the credit-cycle trigger before increasing equity beta.

approval.reason: Strong validation/test risk-adjusted performance with acceptable drawdown.

models.name: S7 Revision-Proxy Growth Rank+
models.note: Version 3.5 revision proxy: acceleration, AI factor score, quality and volatility stability proxy analyst-revision behavior.

parameters.trainingMeaning: Train the price-based revision proxy and volatility-stability penalty.

approval.reason: Strong validation/test risk-adjusted performance with acceptable drawdown.

models.name: S8 Trend-Guarded Reversion+
models.note: Version 3.5 guarded reversion: pullback entries require trend, drawdown, volatility and JP Morgan crowding controls.

parameters.trainingMeaning: Train the pullback signal only under trend-confirmed conditions.

approval.reason: Weak out-of-sample or risk-adjusted evidence under the current settings.

models.name: S9 Sector-Breadth Rotation+
models.note: Version 3.5 sector-breadth rotation: ETF breadth/factor leadership plus JP Morgan regime, liquidity and quality scoring.

parameters.trainingMeaning: Train when broad market participation is strong enough to use a higher equity budget.

approval.reason: Useful signal, but parameters or turnover/drawdown controls need more work.

models.name: S10 Defensive Growth Stabilizer+
models.note: Version 3.5 defensive stabilizer: quality, low-volatility, crowding control and volatility stress hedge.

parameters.trainingMeaning: Train defensive growth allocation and stress hedge size.

approval.reason: Useful signal, but parameters or turnover/drawdown controls need more work.

models.name: S11 Tail-Risk Shock Absorber+
models.note: Version 3.5 tail-risk absorber: JP Morgan regime, low-vol and quality score before shifting into hedges under shock.

parameters.trainingMeaning: Train tail-risk trigger thresholds and hedge severity.

approval.reason: Useful signal, but parameters or turnover/drawdown controls need more work.

models.name: S12 Adaptive Volatility Compounder+
models.note: Version 3.5 adaptive volatility compounder: dynamic target volatility plus JP Morgan liquidity, regime and low-vol scoring.

parameters.trainingMeaning: Train the dynamic volatility target and leverage cap across regimes.

approval.reason: Research candidate only; evidence is not strong enough for approval.
